settings.title: SHIPPING INFORMATION
settings.content:
FREE SHIPPING when you spend over $300, across Australia **

For orders under $300, we offer a fixed rate of $15 per smaller items and $25 per larger items.

* Free Shipping not available during sale periods

** Remote Surcharges may apply for deliveries to remote areas.

See our shipping policy for more details

settings.title: WARRANTY
settings.content:
The Playtime Store products are all covered by a 6 month warranty from the date of purchase, with a valid receipt.

If there is a minor fault, we may in our discretion repair or replace the goods or we may choose to issue a partial/full refund depending on the issue.

Please note that the warranty will be void if the defects are caused by improper use of the product or failure to follow the cleaning and care instructions as stated on our website. For any major faults, The Playtime Store offers a return policy in line with the ACCC Consumer Guarantees

<script>
window.addEventListener('load', function() {
var _learnq = window._learnq || [];
function addedToCart() {
  fetch(`${window.location.origin}/cart.js`)
  .then(res => res.clone().json().then(data => {
    var cart = {
      total_price: data.total_price/100,
      $value: data.total_price/100,
      total_discount: data.total_discount,
      original_total_price: data.original_total_price/100,
      items: data.items
    }
    if (item !== 'undefined') {
      cart = Object.assign(cart, item)
    }
    if (klAjax) {
        _learnq.push(['track', 'Added to Cart', cart]);
        klAjax = false;
      }
  }))
};
(function (ns, fetch) {
  ns.fetch = function() {
    const response = fetch.apply(this, arguments);
    response.then(res => {
      if (`${window.location.origin}/cart/add.js`
      	.includes(res.url)) {
        	addedToCart()
      }
    });
    return response
  }
}(window, window.fetch));
var klAjax = true;
var atcButtons = document.querySelectorAll("form[action*='/cart/add'] button[type='submit']");
for (var i = 0; i < atcButtons.length; i++) {
    atcButtons[i].addEventListener("click", function() {
      if (klAjax) {
        _learnq.push(['track', 'Added to Cart', item]);
        klAjax = false;
      }
    })
}
});
</script>
